Subject: Summer intern rollover — headcount & proposed bands (request)

Hi Grace / Laura,

Attached is the FY27 intern rollover packet for the summer program. We have 6 returner requests (listed on tab 1) and two strong conversion candidates (Emma Zhou, SWE team; Mateo Alvarez on Data infra).

Quick summary:
- Headcount requested: 5 new grad conversions + 1 additional intern rollover slot (total delta +6 HC)
- Proposed bands: new grad base band B2 (reference: current band ranges in tab 2). Emma is a top performer and is recommended at top of B2 + $5k sign-on.
- Cost center: ENG-PLATFORM (charge to Q3 hiring pool, note in Workday ticket HR-1289)

Can you please confirm approval for the headcount and the band/sign-on exception for Emma? If yes, I will prepare offer letters and loop Legal for standard terms.

Attachments: FY27_intern_rollover_summary.xlsx, emma_zhou_assessment_notes.pdf

Best,

Tessa Morgan
Sr. Campus Recruiter | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Summer intern rollover — headcount & proposed bands (request)

Thanks, Tessa — read the packet. A few quick points before I sign off: 

1) Headcount: I can approve +6 HC for FY27 provided the hires are split across Q3/Q4 as you indicated (no single-quarter spend spike). Please add quarter-by-quarter start months on tab 1.

2) Emma: I support a band exception for top-of-band B2 + $5k sign-on, but I need Vivek to OK the sign-on amount (budget out of my org). If Vivek declines, revert to standard top-of-band without sign-on.

3) Legal & comp workflow: Laura, please confirm whether a PAYG sign-on is preferable vs. lump-sum in the offer (and whether there are any policy constraints for interns->FT conversions).

If we get the green light here, Tessa, move ahead with offer drafts and route to Legal + People Ops. Mark the offers as "subject to background check" and include location (SF remote hybrid).

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Summer intern rollover — headcount & proposed bands (request)

Grace / Tessa — quick reply.

- HR has confirmed Q3/Q4 distributions are fine and the headcount pool covers +6 for FY27 under the campus hiring budget. Workday ticket HR-1289 updated (linked).
- Pay: For conversions we generally prefer lump-sum sign-ons above $3k to be split over 6 months for retention accounting. Anything at or below $3k can be one-time. For a $5k request, we should do 50% first paycheck + 50% at 6 months. That avoids budget tagging issues for comp accruals.
- Paperwork: Legal needs the draft offer with any exception clearly annotated. I will open the Workday req and tag for expedited approval.

Please update the draft offers accordingly and circulate.

Laura Bennett
Head of Talent | Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2026 15:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Summer intern rollover — headcount & proposed bands (request)

Thanks for laying this out. Approve the +6 headcount and the sign-on structure Laura proposed. I will approve the $5k sign-on for Emma (50/50 split) given exceptional performance and hard-to-fill SWE role.

Two asks:
- Please add a single sentence in the offer that calls out that sign-on is contingent on continued employment at 6 months for the second tranche.
- Tessa, confirm the start date window (we should aim for earliest start no later than 10/4 to align with roadmap).

Once offers are updated, route to Legal (cc me) and we can issue.

Vivek Kulkarni
VP Engineering | Redwood Inference
